source.campaign_title_visible: Happy Labor Day — Work Builds Stronger Tomorrows

classification.event_product_type: Holiday / community goodwill post with Texas identity (Owner filed under geographic-event)

visual_read.visual_hierarchy: Seller name top-centre → HAPPY LABOR DAY (navy display caps with stars) → 'Work builds stronger tomorrows' → red script wish line → scene → navy band with three service words → red band with URL → 'Bid • Discover • Own'.
visual_read.merchandise_treatment: Representative objects in a staged scene: US flag, Texas-shaped plaque, worn cap and gloves, hand tools on a workbench, insulated tumbler, grill in the background; the cap and tumbler carry printed slogans. No lots are claimed.
visual_read.composition_style: Atmospheric staged scene with golden-hour backlight; type stacked in the sky area; objects along the bottom third; two full-width bands close the ad.
visual_read.typography_treatment: Heavy condensed display caps, a script wish line in red, spaced small caps for services; stars as ornaments.
visual_read.branding_hierarchy: Seller name and descriptor top; services band; URL band; tagline — four brand-level elements.
visual_read.cta_treatment: 'Bid • Discover • Own' — a brand tagline rather than a CTA.
visual_read.footer_treatment: Navy band (Estate Sales | Auctions | Appraisals) over a red band (URL) with a tagline line beneath.
visual_read.photographic_style: Warm cinematic staged scene — reads as a rendered or heavily composited image rather than catalogue photography.
visual_read.environmental_staged_composition: Fully atmospheric; a workbench at sunset with a flag.

strongest_attributes: Regional identity (Texas, Americana) expressed through objects and light rather than a map or a slogan alone
Tools shown as culture — working-class warmth, consistent with the Owner's insistence that tools are a major category
transferable_lessons: Community / holiday posts may use an atmospheric staged scene with representative objects, provided nothing is presented as an auction lot
Geographic identity can be carried by objects and light, not only by place names
Tools and work culture are legitimate subjects for Advantage.Bid brand warmth
do_not_generalize: Slogans printed onto merchandise (cap, tumbler) — the Owner's stated rule for Advantage.Bid is no words on merchandise
Seven copy blocks, two taglines and a services band — far over the Advantage.Bid budget
Patriotic red/navy palette and star ornaments as house style
Rendered/composited imagery as a substitute for real merchandise in any auction creative

text_density_assessment.why_it_works_here: A greeting card tolerates layered messages; it is not selling an event.
text_density_assessment.advantage_bid_budget_note: Not a model for text density. Retrieval must mark this reference 'atmosphere and regional identity only'.

composition_assessment.spatial_logic: A workbench scene with a sky above; type occupies the sky.
composition_assessment.gravity_and_grounding: Objects rest on the bench; flag hangs; real-looking shadows.
composition_assessment.depth: Foreground bench objects, mid grill, background field.
composition_assessment.scale_strategy: Objects small relative to the type; the headline is the hero.
composition_assessment.edge_handling: Flag and grill cropped at the sides.
